subject: Prospect pauses LLM pilot as product redesign takes precedence
messages:
From: Andrew Cho <andrew.cho@sable-systems.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sable-systems.com
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up / schedule

Hi Mateo,

Appreciate the demo last week — your team was great. I wanted to give a quick update from our side: leadership has greenlit a major UX/product redesign that will consume most of our engineering bandwidth for the next two quarters.

Because of that, we need to pause any active LLM/proof-of-concept work for now. We can't commit to the integration window or allocate the engineering support we'd discussed. Procurement is also going to pause contract work until the roadmap settles.

Can we park the pilot? If possible, let's set a tentative check-in for early Q1 (first couple of weeks in Jan) to reassess. If you have a short nurture plan or lightweight eval we can run asynchronously without engineering time, send it over and we'll keep it on file.

Thanks again for the time, and sorry for the churn — it's a timing issue, not a product fit issue.

—Andrew
Andrew Cho
Head of Product, Sable Systems
andrew.cho@sable-systems.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Cho <andrew.cho@sable-systems.com>
Cc: procurement@sable-systems.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up / schedule

Hi Andrew — thanks for the update and totally understandable. Congrats on the redesign priority; that sounds important.

We can absolutely park the pilot. Two quick things to propose so we keep momentum without burdening your team:

1) I'll send a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines a light-touch checklist and an async evaluation path you can run against product mocks. No engineering required.

2) I'll set a tentative reminder for the first business week of January to check in; if your roadmap changes sooner, feel free to ping me.

I'll attach the MAP and the current SOW draft (so procurement has the doc on file). No signatures required now.

Would you prefer a Jan 5–9 check-in window? Happy to book a 30-minute cadence then.

Best,
Mateo
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
attachment: MAP_v2.pdf (one-pager)
attachment: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft, redlines welcome)
From: Andrew Cho <andrew.cho@sable-systems.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up / schedule

Mateo,

Jan 6 would work for a quick check-in — keep it flexible and brief. If you can send the MAP, that'd be helpful for our PM review. Procurement will hold on the SOW for now but appreciates having the draft.

Thanks for being flexible.

—Andrew
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Prospect pauses LLM pilot — nurture + next steps (Sable Systems / DEAL-9845)

Laura / Monica — forwarding the thread from Sable. TL;DR: prospect deprioritized LLM pilot until their UX redesign finishes; asked for a Jan 6 check-in and a light-touch MAP they can review. Procurement asked us to keep the SOW draft on file.

Proposed next steps:
- Laura: please add a "nurture" cadence to the deal in HubSpot, 8-week touch sequence focused on product-readiness content (one-pager MAP, case studies on short integration wins, ROI bullet list). Link: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/9845
- Monica: hold SOW_draft_v1.pdf in the shared drive under DEAL-9845/Sable (no follow-up on pricing now). If procurement asks we'll be ready to re-engage.
- I'll tentatively book a 30-min check-in for Jan 6 (placeholder, will not send calendar invite until we get closer).

Notes for future outreach: avoid heavy engineering asks; prioritize product PM value and low-effort proofs (embeddings or search POC using sample data, not full integration).

If you disagree with any of the above, flag now. Otherwise I'll mark the deal as "nurture" and adjust the forecast.

Thanks — Mateo
